vopros: I run a small service business in Los Angeles and customers keep haggling on price. Who in LA can help me with that?

vyzhimka.tekst:
If the recurring problem is customers saying “that’s too expensive” and negotiating you down, I’d look for help with both pricing strategy and sales/negotiation. Often the fix isn’t simply becoming a tougher negotiator; it’s packaging the service and presenting value so there’s less room to haggle.

In Los Angeles, these are good places to start:

- LA Regional Small Business Development Center (SBDC) — probably my first stop. They provide no-cost, confidential advising to LA-area small businesses, including help with pricing, increasing sales and profitability, and operations. ([smallbizla.org](https://smallbizla.org/?utm_source=openai))
- SCORE Los Angeles — free one-on-one mentoring. Their mentor directory specifically lets you filter for both “Pricing” and “Sales,” as well as service-business industries. ([score.org](https://www.score.org/losangeles/mentors/?utm_source=openai))
- Lapin Negotiation Services — West LA-based and more specialized. They offer one-on-one negotiation coaching and strategy support, so this is more appropriate if you already know your prices are right but need to get better at handling customers who push back. ([lapinnegotiationservices.com](https://lapinnegotiationservices.com/negotiation-services-los-angeles/?utm_source=openai))
- A sales/pricing consultant — potentially worthwhile if this problem is costing you significant revenue, but I wouldn't hire an expensive consultant before trying SBDC or SCORE.

When contacting them, describe the problem specifically: “I run a service business. Customers frequently ask for discounts or try to negotiate my quote. I want help determining whether my pricing/package is wrong and developing a process for handling price objections without unnecessarily losing jobs.”

If you tell me what kind of service business you run (e.g. cleaning, contracting, photography, consulting, auto, beauty) and roughly what you charge, I can also search for 3–5 specific LA advisers who specialize in businesses like yours.
